name: @atlas/backend
description: Atlas RE OS backend — real-estate operating system, powered by AURIC Core (a separate deployment/database from Mizan: see docs note in app/app.module.ts).
comment_dependencies: Deliberately no dependencies/devDependencies of its own — every package below is already installed at the repo root (../../node_modules), and Node/TS module resolution walks up directories to find it. This is NOT an oversight: Core's own source (imported via @core/*) is compiled/run as part of this package too, so a SEPARATE copy of fastify/@nestjs/*/reflect-metadata/kysely here would create a dual-package hazard (two physically different module instances of the same library — breaks NestJS DI's reflect-metadata registry and produces spurious structural type errors on Fastify's plugin types). Always `npm install` at the repo root, never inside atlas/backend.
